about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. The 1.5.0 release decision of 2026-10-23: XC-31 (Release 1.5.0) depended on eleven tasks, of which three were met (XC-17, XC-21, XC-30) and eight were unbuilt work. This amendment makes XC-31 depend on the tasks that are built and claimed on main (XC-17, XC-21, XC-23, XC-25, XC-30 and XC-39 to XC-46), so 1.5.0 ships the thirteen checks added since 1.4.0, and adds XC-48, Release 1.6.0, which depends on the eight tasks 1.5.0 ships without (XC-18, XC-19, XC-22, XC-24, XC-26 to XC-29) and on XC-31. No criterion of any task changes. It becomes binding only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub.

changes.to: As XC-30, for 1.5.0: versions, changelog, corpus-v1.5. 1.5.0 ships the checks built since 1.4.0 (XC-39 to XC-46), the docs sync (XC-23) and the PR summary and badge (XC-25); the eight tasks it shipped without move to XC-48. Publishing stays with the owner.

tasks.title: Release 1.6.0: the rest of the v1.5 build list
tasks.description: As XC-31, for 1.6.0: versions, changelog, corpus-v1.6, once the eight tasks that 1.5.0 shipped without are done: R15 to R19 (XC-18), the implementation matrix (XC-19), the R20 corpus case (XC-22), the n-replica Lean models (XC-24), the framework quickstarts (XC-26), docs examples run by CI (XC-27), the compatibility matrix (XC-28) and the mutation matrix with the false-positive register (XC-29). Publishing stays with the owner.

criteria.statement: Tags v1.6.0 and corpus-v1.6 are on origin (pushed by the owner)

verifier.cmd: git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin refs/tags/v1.6.0 refs/tags/corpus-v1.6 | test $(wc -l) -eq 2

criteria.statement: Every changed file is inside this task's scope
The interdependency map is current and the docs match the code
CHANGELOG's 1.6.0 section names every check it adds (R17, R18, R19) and every task it closes (XC-18, XC-19, XC-22, XC-24, XC-26 to XC-29)

verifier.cmd: python3 -c "import re,sys;s=open('CHANGELOG.md').read();i=s.find('\n## 1.6.0');assert i>=0,'no 1.6.0 section';j=s.find('\n## ',i+1);t=s[i:j if j>0 else len(s)];m=[c for c in 'R17 R18 R19 XC-18 XC-19 XC-22 XC-24 XC-26 XC-27 XC-28 XC-29'.split() if not re.search('(?<![A-Za-z0-9])'+c+'(?![0-9a-z])',t)];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)"

criteria.statement: docs/RELEASES.md has a 1.6.0 section naming every check it adds (R17, R18, R19) and every task it closes (XC-18, XC-19, XC-22, XC-24, XC-26 to XC-29)

verifier.cmd: python3 -c "import re,sys;s=open('docs/RELEASES.md').read();i=s.find('\n## 1.6.0');assert i>=0,'no 1.6.0 section';j=s.find('\n## ',i+1);t=s[i:j if j>0 else len(s)];m=[c for c in 'R17 R18 R19 XC-18 XC-19 XC-22 XC-24 XC-26 XC-27 XC-28 XC-29'.split() if not re.search('(?<![A-Za-z0-9])'+c+'(?![0-9a-z])',t)];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)"
python3 -c "import re,sys;s=open('README.md').read();t=s;m=[c for c in 'R17 R18 R19'.split() if not re.search('(?<![A-Za-z0-9])'+c+'(?![0-9a-z])',t)];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)"

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.
